want: 林道を走れる 2 人乗りの小さな電動のオフロード車両を作りたい。電池で走る 4 輪で、最高 40 km/h、500 kg まで、積載 150 kg。横転しても、乗っている人を守りたい

requirements.name: 使う頻度・年数
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer)

requirements.name: 段差に当たるときの速さ
requirements.basis: A design condition (HIRAKU's default value), set for the strength check of the step. It is not taken from a standard or a catalogue, so it has no outside source. What it gives, by the K2 calculation for the demo vehicle (offroad-4w-v1, two people and cargo): the front wheel force at the step is 3.6 times (100 mm step, 5.7 kN against 1.6 kN) to 4.4 times (250 mm step, 17.6 kN against 4.0 kN) the force of pushing up from rest

requirements.name: 路面の摩擦係数 (砂利)
requirements.basis: assumption (gravel; no public value found)

requirements.name: 路面の粗さ (ISO 8608 のクラス)
requirements.basis: assumption: the forest road taken as ISO 8608 class C. ISO 8608 covers unpaved roads too (https://www.iso.org/standard/71202.html); class C = 128-512 x 10^-6 m^3 at n0 = 0.1 cycle/m from the table in https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12544-013-0127-8 (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 縦の坂 (止まって発進できる一番急な坂)
requirements.basis: 林道規程 (林野庁) 第 20 条: 縦断勾配 12 % は第 1 項のただし書、14 % は第 4 項の 2 級林道の例外 (the steepest stretch), https://www.rinya.maff.go.jp/hokkaido/keikaku/other/attach/pdf/sinrinkeikaku_taikei-32.pdf (the article and its paragraphs read for this repository). The sustained 12 % is the forest loop's grade_high in data/catalog/tests.yaml (P4, T1, T2)

requirements.name: 横の傾き
requirements.basis: assumption (no basis found)

requirements.name: 段差
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 横風 (瞬間)
requirements.basis: 気象庁「風の強さと吹き方」https://www.jma.go.jp/jma/kishou/know/yougo_hp/kazehyo.html (the table is an image, kazehyo.png and kazehyo.pdf): 平均風速 20 m/s is where 「非常に強い風」 begins; 注 2: the gust is often about 1.5 times the mean wind (3 times or more when the air is unstable). So a gust of 30 m/s (1.5 x 20 m/s) (read 2026-11-05)

requirements.name: 気温 (範囲の高い端)
requirements.basis: assumption (the hot end of a -10 to 40 degC range of use)

requirements.name: 水・ほこり (IP)
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer, dust and splashing water on a forest road)

requirements.name: 荷台の固定点 1 か所が受けられる力の下限
requirements.basis: assumption: the smallest row for goods road vehicles borrowed for a much lighter vehicle. EN 12640 as quoted in the European Best Practice Guidelines on Cargo Securing for Road Transport (2014) 2.6, Table 3: vehicle total mass 3.5 to 7.5 t, strength of a lashing point 800 daN (= 8 000 N), read 2026-11-06 (secondary, PDF p. 23); the table has no row below 3.5 t; EN 12640 itself not checked (paid). The CTU Code 6.6.8 says most goods road vehicles have points of LC or MSL 20 kN, read 2026-11-06 (p. 27). No ROV standard or manual read gives a strength for cargo bed anchors

requirements.name: 電線の電流を確かめるときの周りの温度
requirements.basis: assumption: 40 degC is the ambient air temperature of the automotive current rating table in the Anixter catalogue, page 02•43 "Current Ratings for Automotive Cables" (ambient 40 degC, single cable isolated in free air), https://objects.eanixter.com/PD379251-AN.PDF, read 2026-11-06 (secondary: a distributor's technical page). It is the condition of that table, not a measured temperature of this vehicle: near the motor, the controller, the brakes or in the sun it can be higher, and then the table value is too high

requirements.name: 束ねて触れ合う電線の、流してよい電流の割合
requirements.basis: Anixter catalogue, page 02•43 "Current Ratings for Automotive Cables", note: wires grouped and touching, rating factor 2 cables 0.80, 3 0.70, 4 0.65, 5 0.60, 6 0.56, 7 0.53, 8 0.50, https://objects.eanixter.com/PD379251-AN.PDF, read 2026-11-06 (secondary: a distributor's technical page for automotive cable; the standard or calculation behind it is not named). 0.50 (8 cables) is taken so that one number covers a harness of up to 8 touching cables; more than 8 cables is not in the table (not checked). Similar factors for other classes, borrowed and not used: 33 CFR 183 Table 5 note 2 (boats, 7-24 conductors 0.50), DIN VDE 0298-4 Table 21 quoted by Lapp Table 12-6 (industrial cables, 8 cables 0.52)

requirements.name: 回路を守る器具の定格電流の、守る電線の流してよい電流に対する上限の割合
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft and boats. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-48: a circuit breaker is rated so that it opens before the current rating of the wire attached to it is exceeded, read 2026-11-06 (https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf; aircraft wiring). 33 CFR 183.455(c), read 2026-11-06 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I; boats with gasoline engines): not above 150 % of the Table 5 amperage for circuits under 50 V, not above 100 % for 50 V or more (the next larger standard size allowed if it does not exceed 150 %). The 51.2 V circuit is above 50 V, so 1.0 is taken for every circuit. The road-vehicle rules (ISO 8820, ISO 6469-3:2021 clauses 7.1 and 7.2) were not checked

requirements.name: 1 本の電線を曲げる内側の半径の下限 (電線の外径の倍数、動かない所)
requirements.basis: Coficab data sheet FLRY / FLRY sn, rev. AM 09.03.2022, page 1 Technical data: min. bending radius 3 x D (static), https://media.iewc.com/PublicAssets/SpecificationSheets/COF-2010-01-AM-FLRY---FLRY-sn.pdf, read 2026-11-06 (a manufacturer's data sheet, 60 V thin-wall PVC automotive cable, ISO 19642-3 class B). Static only: a cable that moves (to the steering or the suspension) is not covered; for moving flexible cords the Anixter catalogue page 02•67 (after BS 7540, cords up to 450/750 V, borrowed) gives 5D up to 12 mm and 6D above, read 2026-11-06

requirements.name: 束ねた電線を曲げる内側の半径の下限 (束の中でいちばん太い電線の外径の倍数)
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 aa and 11-117: the bend radius of wire groups or bundles not less than 10 times the outside diameter of the largest wire (3 times in 11-96 aa, 6 times in 11-117, where suitably supported at breakouts or reversals), read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. No road-vehicle value for a bundle was read

requirements.name: 配線を支える点どうしの間隔の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 a and 11-146: wires and cables supported at intervals not more than 24 in (= 609.6 mm, computed) unless in troughs, ducts or conduits; 11-118: normally not more than 1/2 in (12.7 mm) deflection between supports, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. A public road-vehicle spacing (SAE J1292, an OEM harness guide) was not found; this vehicle shakes more on rough tracks than an aircraft in normal flight, so the borrowed value may be too long (not checked)

requirements.name: 板や縁を通り抜ける所での、配線と縁の隙間の下限 (留められない所)
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-115: protective grommets wherever wires cannot be clamped, so that there is at least 3/8 in (= 9.525 mm, computed) clearance from structure at penetrations, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. 33 CFR 183.445(a) (boats) asks that a conductor through a bulkhead or other rigid surface is protected from abrasion, with no number, read 2026-11-06 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I)

requirements.name: 動かして操作する仕組みと配線の隙間の下限
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 dd (mechanical control cables) and 11-125 (movable controls): at least 1/2 in (= 12.7 mm, computed) between wiring and the controls when the bundle is pushed with light hand pressure toward them, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf

requirements.name: 人数と荷重の組 (見る組)
requirements.basis: request (2 人乗り、積載 150 kg)
requirements.note: MVP は two_cargo (2 人 + 荷) だけを見る。empty・driver・two はまだ見ない。乗員と荷は設計の部品 (kind occupant / cargo)

requirements.name: 体格の範囲
requirements.value: 若年女性 5 % 〜 若年男性 95 %
requirements.basis: AIST 人体寸法データベース 1991-92, 項目 B1 身長, 若年 (young adults), パーセンタイル 5 % の女性 1511.2 mm から 95 % の男性 1819.6 mm, https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html (B1 table read 2026-11-06)

requirements.name: 体重 (強さの不利側)
requirements.basis: AIST 人体寸法データベース 1991-92, 項目 N1 体重, 若年男性 95 パーセンタイル, https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html (N1 table read 2026-11-06)

requirements.name: 弱い人がいるか
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer)

requirements.name: 頭を後ろから受け止める高さの下限 (座席の基準点から、胴の線に沿って上へ)
requirements.basis: assumption: a passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. UN Regulation No. 17, 08 series (MLIT English/Japanese text, https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R017.pdf), para. 5.6.2 and 5.6.3.1 (front seats not less than 800 mm, other seats 750 mm) and para. 6.5.4 (the height is from the R point, the seating reference point of para. 2.13, to the tangent at the top, measured along the manikin's torso reference line), read 2026-11-06; R17 applies to M1 and N1 (para. 1). 49 CFR 571.202a (FMVSS 202a, eCFR current text, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-49/subtitle-B/chapter-V/part-571/subpart-B/section-571.202a) S4.2.1(a)(1) (front outboard not less than 800 mm in at least one position) with S3 (height from the H-point parallel to the torso reference line), read 2026-11-06; it applies to passenger cars and to MPVs, trucks and buses of 4,536 kg GVWR or less (S2). UN R25 was not checked (not reachable). No text read requires this for an off-road utility or recreational vehicle; ANSI/ROHVA 1, ANSI/OPEI B71.9 and SAE J2258 were not checked

requirements.name: 頭を後ろから受け止める面の左右の幅の下限
requirements.basis: assumption: a passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. UN Regulation No. 17, 08 series (https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R017.pdf) para. 5.11 (not less than 85 mm to each side of the seat's vertical median plane; 2 x 85 = 170 mm computed) and para. 6.6.1 (measured in a plane 65 mm below the top, perpendicular to the torso reference line), read 2026-11-06, for M1 and N1. 49 CFR 571.202a S4.2.2 (not less than 170 mm at 65 ±3 mm below the top; 254 mm for a front outboard seat when a front centre seat exists), eCFR current text, read 2026-11-06, for US passenger cars and light vehicles (S2)

requirements.name: 頭の後ろと、それを受け止める面との前後のすき間の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: a US passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. 49 CFR 571.202a S4.2.3 (front outboard backset not more than 55 mm) with S3 (backset = the minimum horizontal distance from the rear of the head of a seated 50th percentile male, head restraint measurement device on the SAE J826 manikin, to the head restraint) and S5.2.3 (top set between 750 and 800 mm, seat back at the design angle), eCFR current text, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-49/subtitle-B/chapter-V/part-571/subpart-B/section-571.202a, read 2026-11-06; applies to passenger cars and MPVs, trucks and buses of 4,536 kg GVWR or less (S2). UN R17 08 series has no backset limit (the word does not occur in the MLIT text, read 2026-11-06); later R17 series and UN R25 were not checked

requirements.name: 背もたれと、頭を受け止める部分のあいだのすき間の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: a passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. UN Regulation No. 17, 08 series (https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R017.pdf) para. 5.8 (no gap of more than 60 mm between the seat back and a head restraint not adjustable for height; 25 mm in the lowest position if adjustable) and para. 6.7.1 (gaps measured with a 165 mm sphere), read 2026-11-06, for M1 and N1. 49 CFR 571.202a S4.2.4.1 (no gap greater than 60 mm with a 165 mm sphere), eCFR current text, read 2026-11-06, for US passenger cars and light vehicles

requirements.name: 電池の端子から、最初に回路を守る器具までの電線の長さの上限
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from boats. 33 CFR 183.460(a): each ungrounded output conductor from a storage battery has a trip-free circuit breaker or fuse within 72 in (= 1828.8 mm, computed) of the battery, measured along the conductor (the cranking motor feed is excepted); 183.455(b) puts the device at the source of power, or within 7 in (177.8 mm), or within 40 in (1016 mm) if the conductor is sheathed, read 2026-11-06, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I (boats with gasoline engines). The longest of these is taken; a road-vehicle value was not checked

requirements.name: 積載
requirements.basis: request
requirements.note: 乗員とは別の荷として扱う (聞いていない)

requirements.name: 荷の重心の高さ (荷台の床から)
requirements.basis: the demo design's cargo: its box centre at 600 mm stands 150 mm above the deck's top at 450 mm (data/designs/offroad-4w-v1.json, parts cargo and deck)

requirements.name: 足を置く面どうしの高さの差の上限 (段と段、最後の段から床まで)
requirements.basis: ISO 4252:1983 Table 1 (between steps max 300 mm; last step to door sill max 300 mm), read 2026-11-04; ISO 2867:1994 Table 1 B (riser 230 to 400 mm, basic 300 mm), read 2026-11-04. Both are an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read)

requirements.name: 足を置く面の幅の下限
requirements.basis: ISO 4252:1983 Table 1 (width of step min 150 mm; footnote: for practical reasons not less than 250 mm), read 2026-11-04; ISO 2867:1994 Table 1 C (one foot 160 mm min, both feet 320 mm min), read 2026-11-04. Both are an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read)

requirements.name: 足を置く面の外の縁から先の、つま先が入る空きの下限
requirements.basis: ISO 4252:1983 Table 1 (clearance from the outside edge of the step min 150 mm), read 2026-11-04; ISO 2867:1994 Table 1 F2 (toe clearance min 150 mm, basic 200 mm), read 2026-11-04. Both are an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read)

requirements.name: 開口を、乗る人が道具なしに片手・一つの動作で開けられること
requirements.basis: assumption. CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964, preamble (occupant retention), read 2026-11-04, accepts a barrier the occupant puts in place with one hand in one operation, such as a door (said of closing; applied here to opening). 道路運送車両の保安基準 第25条第3項, read 2026-11-04: 鎖・ロープなど転落を防ぐ装置は扉の代わりになる. No force or time for opening was found

requirements.name: 乗り降りの手がかりの高さの上限 (足を置く面から上へ)
requirements.basis: ISO 2867:1980 7.8 (grab rails begin at max 1 600 mm above the ground or platform; continue to at least 900 mm above the last step), read 2026-11-04; ISO 2867:1994 Table 2 D, not checked here. an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read). Whether a hand hold is required at all for a floor below 1 m was not found in any source read (ISO 2867:1994 4.7 asks for three-point support above 1 m)

requirements.name: 手でつかむ所の太さ (直径か平行な面の間) の下限
requirements.basis: ISO 2867:1980 7.3 (grab rail or handle: 16 mm min, 25 mm recommended, 38 mm max), read 2026-11-04; ISO 2867:1994 Table 2 A (16 mm min, 38 mm max, 25 mm basic), read 2026-11-04. Both are an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read)

requirements.basis: request

requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from 細目告示 第171条 第5項 第3号's table, https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/content/S171.pdf (the 2021.6.9 text): the row for a maximum speed of 35 km/h or more and under 80 km/h (initial speed 35 km/h, stopping distance 14 m or less), a borrowing and not a row for this vehicle's kind (the same table's row for 20 km/h or more and under 35 km/h: initial speed 20 km/h, 5 m or less) (read 2026-11-05)

requirements.name: 止まっていられる坂
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from 細目告示 第171条 第5項 第5号, https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/content/S171.pdf (the 2021.6.9 text): 「5 分の 1 こう配」 (20 %), not a requirement for this vehicle's kind (read 2026-11-05)

requirements.name: 航続
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 最低地上高
requirements.basis: EU 規則 168/2013 附属書 I (全地形車 L7e-B の下限), criterion (8) "ground clearance ≥180 mm", https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2013/168/annex/I; read 2026-11-03 in a source check

requirements.name: 最小回転半径の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: the 12 m of a motor vehicle on a public road and of the design vehicle of a forest road, applied to a vehicle on private land. 道路運送車両の保安基準 第 6 条第 1 項 (最小回転半径は、最外側のわだちについて 12 m 以下), read 2026-11-05 in the e-Gov law text (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/326M50000800067). 林業専用道作設指針 (林野庁長官通知 平成 22 年 9 月 24 日 22林整整第 602 号) 第 3 の 1 (設計車両 普通自動車 最小回転半径 12 m) と 6 (曲線半径は原則 12 m 以上), read 2026-11-05 (https://www.rinya.maff.go.jp/j/seibi/saisei/pdf/rinngyousenyou.pdf). The narrower curves of the 林道規程 (design speed 20 km/h: class 1 15 m, class 2 12 m, class 3 6 m) come from the 森林総合研究所 Q&A (https://www.ffpri.go.jp/qa/management/qa-manage3.html), a secondary page; the text of the 林道規程 was not checked

requirements.name: 荷と荷台の床のあいだの摩擦係数 (止まっているときの値)
requirements.basis: assumption: the container and road rule borrowed. CTU Code (MSC.1/Circ.1497) Annex 7, 2.2.2.3 and the note of Appendix 2: a material pair not in the table or not verified, max 0.3; frost, ice, snow 0.2; oily or greasy 0.1, read 2026-11-06 (p. 95-96, p. 129). Pairs in Appendix 2 (p. 128-129, read 2026-11-06): sawn timber vs plywood 0.45, plastic pallet vs stainless steel 0.15, rubber vs other materials 0.6, and others listed in .notes/R3-sources.md. The same table is quoted from EN 12195-1:2010 Annex B in the EU Best Practice Guidelines (2014) Appendix 3, read 2026-11-06 (secondary). Values for swept clean surfaces, static friction

requirements.name: 操舵の回転を折って伝える所の、1 か所あたりの折れ角の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: the maximum operating angle of one maker's single steering universal joints, applied to the joints of this vehicle, whose maker is not chosen. Borgeson Universal, "U-Joint & Shaft General Instructions" (sheet dated 3/20/2018), item 1): single joints 35 degrees, double joints 70 degrees, beyond which the joint can bind and be damaged; read 2026-11-06 (https://sdda.semadata.org/Standard/Borgeson/JOINT_SHAFT_GENERAL.pdf). These are aftermarket steering joints of cars. Industrial joints are rated otherwise (read 2026-11-06): Huco Universal Joints catalogue section 2, PDF p. 8, needle roller T series 40 deg single, 80 deg double; PDF p. 9, plain bearing DIN 808 joints 45 deg single, 90 deg double; PDF p. 6, plain T series sizes 50 and up 30 deg (https://theengineer.markallengroup.com/production/content/uploads/2012/05/universal_joints.pdf); Timken NB10-UJ needle bearing type, max operating angle for power transmission 25 deg (https://cad.timken.com/printitem/needle-bearing-type-universal-joints/eedle-bearing-type-universal-solid-joints-imperial/68514415607). Borgeson's web page (https://www.borgeson.com/joints.html) was not checked (403). The joint actually chosen and its catalogue win over this value

requirements.name: ハンドルから車輪の側へ伝わる回転のむらの上限
requirements.basis: assumption: the example value of an allowable torque variation rate in a passenger-car steering design tool, applied to this vehicle. NSK Ltd, US 8,965,743 B2 (granted 2015-02-24), description of FIG. 21-27: the allowable torque variation rate is "for example, 10%" (FIG. 23-27 compare 10 % down to 3 %); the torque variation rate is the ratio of input to output torque, the inverse of the angular velocity ratio (its Equation (5) is an image and was not read); read 2026-11-06 in the Google Patents text (https://patents.google.com/patent/US8965743B2/en). HIRAKU takes the rate as the largest deviation of the output-to-input speed ratio from 1 over one turn (an assumption about the patent's definition). The ratio of one joint, w_out/w_in = cos a / (1 - cos^2 t * sin^2 a) (a = angle between the shafts, t = turn of the input from the position where its arm of the cross lies in the plane of the two shafts), max 1/cos a, min cos a: Mustansiriyah University lecture note "universal joint", PDF p. 7-8, read 2026-11-06 (secondary) (https://uomustansiriyah.edu.iq/media/lectures/5/5_2021_12_11!08_27_23_PM.pdf); the same range w cos a to w sec a in Huco Universal Joints catalogue section 2, PDF p. 2, read 2026-11-06. No standard for steering was read

load_cases.title: 2 人と荷を載せて、段差に速さを持って当たる衝撃

criterion.basis: min(y_tube 245 MPa, y_mech 215 MPa) / Q61 1.5 (materials stkr400, stkm13a: not checked)

load_cases.basis: 段差の高さは Q15 (100 mm、前提)、当たる速さは Q04 (10 km/h、HIRAKU の設計の条件で出典なし)、載せる組は Q30 (two_cargo)。前の 2 輪が段差に当たるときの衝撃で骨組みに出る応力を、骨組みの鋼 (STKR400 と STKM13A) の降伏の小さい方を Q61 の安全率で割った値と比べる。落錘・落下は、この車の使い方 (林道を走る) では段差の衝撃で代表させる (前提)

load_cases.title: 横転したときの乗員の空間: ロールバーを横・後ろから押してエネルギーを吸わせ、上から押しつぶし、どの押し方でも乗員の空間に入らないか (OECD Code 4 の静的試験の形を借りる、2 人 + 荷)
load_cases.basis: 押す量は Q86 の基準の質量 M に OECD Standard Code 4 (2026-02) 3.5.2.1・3.5.3.1・3.6.1 の係数 (横 1.75 M J・後ろ 1.4 M J・上 20 M N) を掛けたもので、同じ実行の R4 の荷重条件 (R4 builder が Q86 から出した値) から写した。Code 4 は 600 kg 以上のトラクタの規格で、この車に借りるのは仮定。後ろの力の位置 rear_fraction (上の梁の幅の 1/6) も R4 と同じ。限度は Code 4 3.5.2.2・3.5.3.2・3.8 の「どの押し方でも構造が乗員の空間 (k4_geometry.occupant_spaces、AIST の若年男性 95 % で広げた箱) に入らない」で、距離 0 mm 以上 (式の 0 * rollbar_t は、限度 0 に長さの単位を持たせるためだけのもので、ロールバーの肉厚には意味を持たせていない)。押し方は 1 つずつ組んだままの枠から (前の押し方の残りの変形を持ち越さない。Code 4 は順に押す)。横・後ろ・上は 1 つの荷重条件にまとめ、判定は 3 つのうち最も小さい距離 (式 frame_static.rops_occupant_clearance と同じ)。C3 を解くツールは棚にまだ無い (R4 の rollover_beam は落とす動的な解析で、試験 R4 だけ)。

load_cases.title: 悪路を走る振動で、電池の取付が受ける疲労
load_cases.basis: 路面は Q12 (ISO 8608 のクラス C、前提)、距離は Q90 (5000 km、前提)、速さは Q50 の最高速度 40 km/h で走り続けるとみる (不利側の前提)、載せる組は Q30 (two_cargo)。電池の重さが路面の振動で取付 (金具・溶接) をくり返し揺らす損傷をマイナー則で数え、損傷 1 (壊れる所) を限度とする。電池の規格の振動試験 (UN 38.3 など) は確かめていないので使わない
